ModMetaData.name: Image Opt Compatibility Patch
ModMetaData.author: DegradingAnt
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility patch FOR Image Opt - you still need Image Opt installed. It does not replace or modify Image Opt; it patches around it.
Built and tested on a 1,478-mod list (the Progression pack) where Image Opt otherwise black-screened at load.
WHAT IT DOES 1. Vehicle readback fix - Vehicle Framework rebuilds vehicle liveries by reading and rewriting texture pixels. Image Opt's native textures live on the GPU and cannot serve a CPU read. Textures belonging to vehicle mods are replaced with CPU-readable copies. 2. Early-load guards - Vanilla Expanded Framework and Worldbuilder touch data that is not ready yet during the pre-load screen. Image Opt lengthens that window enough to throw an exception every frame, which blanks the screen. Both are guarded until the data exists. 3. Orphaned .dds.zstd sweep - removes Image Opt cache files whose source image no longer exists, which otherwise get served as stale textures. It only ever touches .dds.zstd, never plain .dds.
Everything is a no-op when Image Opt is not active.
KNOWN GAPS - please read - The vehicle livery has not been visually confirmed. Textures convert without errors, but nobody has yet checked a turret on the paint page. - The vehicle list is hardcoded to ten mods. Other mods that read texture pixels may need adding. - Most fixes touch Unity types that the test suite cannot load, so they are verified by inspection, not by tests.
Written with AI assistance and reviewed by a second independent AI reviewer. Source, known issues and the review notes are on GitHub. Fixes welcome - MIT licensed.
